recognize_zh: 四格末梢血中的分葉中性球細胞質裡可見淡藍色、邊界模糊的大塊包涵體（類似 Döhle body，但無感染時的毒性顆粒），同時視野中有接近紅血球大小的巨大血小板；在血小板低下的孩童，這樣的組合要想到 MYH9 相關疾病（May-Hegglin 異常）。
features: Mature segmented neutrophils with pale blue, ill-defined cytoplasmic inclusions (Döhle-like bodies), best seen in panels C and D
Neutrophil granulation otherwise normal without toxic granulation or vacuolization
Giant platelet approaching red cell size (panel C, lower field); other platelets small and sparse, consistent with thrombocytopenia
Red cells normocytic and normochromic without significant poikilocytosis
Image resolution limits fine assessment of inclusion shape
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows segmented neutrophils containing pale blue, poorly demarcated cytoplasmic inclusions resembling Döhle bodies, without accompanying toxic granulation or vacuolization. Platelets appear decreased, and at least one giant platelet approaching the size of a red cell is present. Red cell morphology is unremarkable. In a pediatric patient with thrombocytopenia, the combination of Döhle-like neutrophil inclusions and macrothrombocytes is suggestive of an MYH9-related disorder (May-Hegglin anomaly); confirmation by NMMHC-IIA immunofluorescence or MYH9 genetic testing is recommended to avoid misdiagnosis as immune thrombocytopenia.

ddx.vs: ITP may have mildly enlarged platelets but neutrophils lack Döhle-like inclusions, and platelet size is not uniformly giant.
Reactive Döhle bodies are smaller, peripheral, and accompanied by toxic granulation and vacuoles, without giant platelets or chronic thrombocytopenia.
Bernard-Soulier has giant platelets but normal neutrophils, and platelets fail to agglutinate with ristocetin due to GPIb-IX-V deficiency.
Chédiak-Higashi shows giant coarse azurophilic/peroxidase-positive granules in granulocytes rather than pale blue amorphous inclusions.
